name: Red Lentil Dal with Sweet Potato & Spinach
subtitle: Instant Pot masoor dal finished with a sizzling cumin-garlic tadka, with Greek-yogurt flatbreads and cumin yogurt
equipment: Instant Pot, 12-inch skillet (nonstick or cast iron), rolling pin

macros.portion: About 1¾ cups dal, 2 flatbreads and ½ cup cumin yogurt.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. One flatbread instead of two takes off about 90 kcal.

before: Start **~60 min** before dinner. The flatbreads get rolled and cooked while the Instant Pot is under pressure.
notes: The tadka at the end is what makes dal taste like a restaurant's: whole spices and garlic fried in ghee and poured over at the last second, while they're still sizzling. Mustard seeds should pop before the cumin goes in. Pour the tomatoes on top and don't stir them in before pressure cooking: tomatoes on the bottom scorch and set off the burn warning. Dal thickens as it sits, so loosen leftovers with a splash of water when reheating. The flatbread dough is just flour, Greek yogurt and baking powder. It starts sticky, so flour your hands and the counter; a 10-minute rest makes it much easier to roll.

items: 1¼ cups all-purpose flour, plus more for rolling
2 dried red chiles or ½ tsp red pepper flakes
½ tsp Kashmiri chili powder or paprika

steps.title: Flatbread dough
steps.body: In a bowl, whisk **1¼ cups flour + 2 tsp baking powder + ½ tsp salt**. Stir in **1¼ cups Greek yogurt** until shaggy, then knead in the bowl about 1 min with floured hands until it holds together. Cover and let it rest while you do the rest of the prep.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Dice **1 onion**. Mince **4 cloves garlic** and grate **1 Tbsp ginger** into one small bowl. Peel **2 sweet potatoes** and cut into 1-inch cubes. Rinse **1 lb red lentils** in a strainer until the water runs mostly clear. Thinly slice **2 more cloves garlic** for the tadka and set aside.

steps.title: Bloom and soften
steps.body: Instant Pot on Sauté (high). Add **1 Tbsp oil** and **1 tsp cumin seeds**; stir 30 seconds until a shade darker. Add the onion and cook 4–5 min until soft and starting to brown. Add the garlic and ginger, 1 min, then **1 tsp turmeric + 1 tsp coriander**, 30 seconds.

steps.title: Fill, but don't stir in the tomatoes
steps.body: Pour in **4½ cups water** and scrape the bottom completely clean. Add the lentils, sweet potatoes and **1¼ tsp salt** and stir. Pour **1 can diced tomatoes** over the top and leave them there.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.body: Cancel Sauté. Lid on, valve sealed. High pressure **6 min**, then natural release **10 min**, then vent.

steps.title: Flatbreads, yogurt and tadka setup
steps.body: During the pressure time: cut the dough into **8** pieces. On a floured counter, roll each to about 6 inches across and ⅛ inch thick. Heat the dry skillet over medium-high and cook each flatbread **1–2 min** per side until puffed and spotted brown. Stack them under a towel. Stir **2 cups Greek yogurt + ½ tsp ground cumin + ¼ tsp salt**. Wipe the flour out of the skillet and set out **1½ Tbsp ghee**, **½ tsp mustard seeds + 1 tsp cumin seeds**, the sliced garlic, **2 dried chiles** and **½ tsp Kashmiri chili powder** beside it.

steps.title: Finish the dal
steps.body: Open the pot and whisk until the lentils break down and the dal is creamy. Stir in **5 oz spinach**, **2 Tbsp lemon juice** and **½ tsp garam masala** until the spinach wilts. Taste for salt. It should be thick enough to mound on rice. If it's stiffer than you like, add hot water a splash at a time.

steps.title: Tadka
steps.body: Same skillet over medium-high. Add the ghee and tilt the pan so it pools on one side. When it shimmers, add the mustard seeds and wait for them to pop (about 30 seconds), then the cumin seeds for 15 seconds. Add the garlic and cook until golden at the edges, 30–45 seconds. Add the chiles, take it off the heat, stir in the chili powder, and pour everything over the dal right away.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Dal in bowls with cumin yogurt on top and flatbreads for scooping.

after: Pack 2 lunches: dal in one container, yogurt separate, flatbreads wrapped. Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan or toaster; 15 seconds in the microwave works but they turn chewy.

source.label: Standard masoor dal tadka method, adapted for the Instant Pot
